name: Chickpea-Tomato Noodle Soup with Kale Caesar & Breadsticks

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince onion and garlic. Place half the garlic in a large bowl and set aside for the salad dressing.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and remaining garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add broth, tomato sauce, pasta, and spices to the pot; stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until noodles are just tender, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1065 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
227 g penne pasta
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut flatbreads into 1½-inch wide strips, place on a large baking sheet pan, and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 flatbreads or naan
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: While the breadsticks are baking, wash, dry, and juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, Dijon, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp soy sauce
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing; toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Once the pasta is tender, add chickpeas to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls and serve with salad and breadsticks on the side. Top soup and salad with cheese and enjoy!
